name: GetMetrics

parameters.help_en: The namespace for cloud service monitoring data. For more information about namespaces, see cloud service monitoring metrics
parameters.help_zh: 云产品的数据命名空间。关于云产品的数据命名空间，请参见云产品监控项
parameters.name: namespace

parameters.help_en: The number of records per query for paged queries. Default value: 1000
parameters.help_zh: 每次查询大小，用于分页查询，默认值为1000
parameters.name: length

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query. Default value: current time
parameters.help_zh: 查询的截止时间，默认值：当前
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The statistical period for monitoring data. Unit: seconds. Valid values: 15, 60, 900, and 3600
parameters.help_zh: 监控数据的统计周期。单位：秒。取值：15、60、900和3600
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en: The pagination cursor token. If you do not set this parameter, the first page of data is returned. When a NextToken value is returned, more data is available. Use the returned NextToken as a parameter in your next request to retrieve the next page. Repeat until NextToken returns null, which means all data has been retrieved
parameters.help_zh: 分页游标标识。说明 如果不设置该参数，则表示获取第一页的数据。当该参数有返回值时，说明还有下一页，您可以将返回的NextToken作为参数再次请求获得下一页的数据，直到返回为Null为止，表示获取到了所有的数据
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: Metric name. Not filled. Not in use
parameters.help_zh: metric名称。未填充，不在使用中
parameters.name: metric_name

parameters.help_en: The start time of the monitoring data query interval (UTC). Default value: one hour ago
parameters.help_zh: 查询监控数据的时间区间的起始时间（UTC），默认值是1小时前
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: A temporary token used for authentication
parameters.name: token

Code.description_en: The status code. A value of 200 indicates success

Period.description_en: The statistical period for monitoring data. Valid values: 15, 60, 900, and 3600. Unit: seconds. If you do not specify a statistical period, the system uses the reporting period registered for the metric. Each cloud service metric (MetricName) may have a different statistical period. For more information, see cloud service monitoring metrics
Period.description_zh: 监控数据的统计周期。取值：15、60、900和3600。单位：秒。说明 如果不设置统计周期，则按照注册监控项时申请的上报周期来查询监控数据。每个云产品的监控项（MetricName）的统计周期不同。更多信息，请参见云产品监控项

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the operation succeeded. Valid values: true (success) and false (failure)
Success.description_zh: 操作是否成功。取值：true：成功。false：失败
